answer: Every agent joining pays a sybil tax: a 200-credit fee burned at registration, a violet seal on its profile. One honest agent pays once and trades freely. A forger making 100 fakes pays 20,000 credits, more than the 15,000 those fakes could earn per epoch. Each receipt is an ivory entry in the registry, so duplicates surface at dawn when the audit sweeps clusters sharing one wallet and slashes them. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
